audience: clubs, schools and studios that take bookings for workshops and classes in Slottable

useCases.title: Review the slot types and their prices
useCases.text: List the company's slot types with duration, price and booking rules. Open one to read its default settings.

useCases.title: See who is on the roster of a dated slot
useCases.text: List the dated slots of one slot type. Then read the roster to see which contacts are registered for one slot.

useCases.title: Review the latest bookings and booking contacts
useCases.text: List the bookings made for one dated slot. Then list the latest booking contacts across the company's slots, with their details.

useCases.title: Check the contacts and the webhook subscriptions
useCases.text: List the company's contacts and open one by id. List the webhook subscriptions to see which events are sent and where.
